Closed 2026-09-17 as superseded, in single-developer mode (AGENTS.md SD4). Audit against main 0df1d9e7.

Landed in reduced form: the portable adapter acquire/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/acquire/sherlock.scala plus SherlockAnnotationsSuite (13 courts) and the embed-bench bridge, commit 23b224f0 (2026-09-01). The deviation from this bead's .jvm layout was decided under SD5 and is recorded on closed bead bd-01M1EYV5XKHBBFPPB9J7C2J0JG. None of the seven paths named here exist and no docs/data/sherlock/d0-replay-receipt.json exists.

Still unbuilt from this bead: emission of NarrativeSourceAtlas units with typed EvidenceSupport (both exist in core with zero production callers), TopicHmmEvent30 as a population, alias-map replay, the deterministic replay receipt, and a Sherlock construction-boundary probe.

Why not rewrite: docs/plans/2026-09-17-annotation-intake-contract.md (revision 3) P5 points the adapter the opposite way from this bead: out of acquire into a JVM-only corpus-intake module, reading timebase-repair.json instead of literals, and it names the current adapter's literal-vs-literal test as defect D6 and the unread source-manifest.json as D5. The residual items above belong to that plan's P5 slice; EvidenceSupport emission is D1A's consumer question (bd-01M1CQKRG1A4J4BEWCC78F4TEZ). Dependents D1B and E0 remain blocked on D1A only.
